task: Build a transparent geospatial levelized-cost model to estimate the delivered cost of African green hydrogen to Europe (via ammonia shipping and reconversion) by 2030 under multiple financing and policy scenarios
methodological_commitments: Geospatial LCOH model following GeoH2 / Müller et al. framework
Ammonia as hydrogen carrier for transshipment to Europe
Multiple financing scenarios varying WACC/discount rate
Comparison with European domestic green hydrogen production baseline
Quantify de-risking impact on cost competitiveness
target_artifacts: Map of delivered cost to Europe
